title: Tsu Kung Fah

page_data.en:
Commandant SVC
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL UNPLEASE return this file to the CENTRAL REGISTRY when finished with）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 215
Date 21-1-16
21st January 1916
Sir,
It is reported that the rebels here have received a sum of $200,000.00 from Japan, the money having been collected among Chinese residing in that country.
It is reported that on 20th inst Admiral Liu gave a dinner to the officers of the Chinese warships in port, at which he announced the intention of the Central Government to discontinue using Shanghai as a naval base. It is now said that the naval officers will turn rebel if the Central Government carries out its intention.
It is reported that the military land in Pootung has, with official approval, been mortgaged to the Bank of China by the local gentry for $50,000.00. The money will be used to relieve distress in Pootung.
It is reported that 2,000 refugees from the hinterland of Pootung appeared at Loh Ka Ang 陆家巷 yesterday and it is thought that they intend to come to Shanghai.
It is reported that a warship with 2,000 rifles on board left the Arsenal for Peking this morning.
With reference to the arrest of a Chinese detective named Tsu Kung Fah 周根法 for giving false information against a wharf coolie, the detective in question is still on remand. An additional charge of making false rebel certificates of appointment has been preferred against him.
There are rumours that Chen Chi May 陈其美 is at present living in the French Concession that he keeps moving from one house to another so that it is difficult to locate him for any length of time.
Liu Nyoh Zung 刘耀成 the assassin of the bank manager Tsang Zau Lien 张绍谦 has told a story to the Military Court which is very different to that which he gave to the French Police. He now says that Tsang 张 was assassinated at the instigation of that section of the rebel party which acknowledges Chen Che May 陈其美 as its head and that he and his accomplice were to be paid $80.00 and were each to receive the command of a Regiment for doing the deed. $30.00 out of the $80.00 was paid in advance. The plan was matured in a lodging house in the French Concession and four days were spent in shadowing the victim before they had an opportunity of firing at him as he sat in the carriage.

警务处，
（侦探股）
刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 215 号
日期 16-1-21
1916年1月21日

先生：

据报，此地的反叛者已从日本获得一笔二十万美元的款项，该笔资金系向居住在该国的华人募集而来。

据报，本月20日，刘海军上将宴请了停泊在港内的中国军舰军官，席间他宣布中央政府打算不再将上海作为海军基地。现称，如果中央政府执行其意图，海军军官将会倒戈成为反叛者。

据报，浦东的军用土地已获官方批准，由当地士绅抵押给中国银行，作价五万美元。该笔款项将用于救济浦东的灾民。

据报，昨日有两千名来自浦东内地的难民出现在陆家巷（Loh Ka Ang），预计他们打算进入上海。

据报，一艘载有两千支步枪的军舰今晨离开兵工厂前往北京。

关于一名名为周根法（Tsu Kung Fah）的华籍侦探因提供针对码头苦力的虚假信息而被捕一事，该侦探目前仍被还押候审。另对他提出一项伪造反叛者委任状的附加指控。

有谣言称，陈其美（Chen Chi May）目前居住在法租界，他频繁更换住所，因此难以长时间锁定其行踪。

刺杀银行经理张绍谦（Tsang Zau Lien）的凶手刘耀成（Liu Nyoh Zung）向军事法庭陈述的故事，与他此前向法国警察提供的供词大相径庭。他现在声称，刺杀张绍谦是受承认陈其美（Chen Che May）为首领的那部分反叛党派指使，他和同伙为此事成事后可获得八十美元报酬，并各获授一个团的指挥权。八十美元中的三十美元已预先支付。该计划是在法租界的一处寄宿寓所内策划成熟的，他们在有机会向坐在马车里的受害者开枪之前，花了四天时间进行跟踪监视。

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG    191
No. 21
Date. 21 . 1 . 26

2

The assassins who did not count on being captured
had arranged to meet after the murder in another
lodging house on the opposite side of the street
to that in which they dwelt during the four
days preceding the murder.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmm Armstrong

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on M.S. Jan. 21.
